title: Her father's day job as a butcher
summary: Her father was a butcher at the meat markets, which closed at noon and left time for music.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Did your father work in music full-time or did he have another trade?
Oh, no, he was a butcher. He was a butcher. Yeah. He was a butcher.
Most of the musicians worked that as a sideline a lot of times just on weekends.
Yeah, well, he was a butcher all these lines. And that gave him time for...
Just worked at night then occasionally.
Yeah, he had a lot of time then for the braids and all of that, you know, because he was finished at 12 o'clock. The markets used to close then at 12 o'clock.
Oh, that's right. They opened up real early. I've heard how the French market did that way.
They were regular markets. There was nothing else sold in them but meat. Just meat. And they would close at 12, so that would give him time.
